Transparently documented in plan.md and the green audit JSON.

NB-2: HauntedLibraryGame.tsx initializes one idempotencyKey per component mount and reuses it across game restarts (Review B NB-1). A second completion in the same session would be treated as a duplicate. Regenerate the key at the start of each new game in Phase 5+.

NB-3: page.tsx handleComplete parameter type is spelled out inline rather than importing GameCompletionInput from @reading-advantage/domain/games (Review C NB-1). Phase 5+ migration can replace inline types with domain imports.

NB-4: The Red 'adds a victory bonus' test input was adjusted from accuracy:1/totalAttempts:5 to accuracy:0.5/totalAttempts:10 to isolate the +1 victory bonus (the spec formula awards +2 when computed accuracy is 1, which would have conflated accuracy and victory bonuses). Test name and intent preserved. Documented in plan.md and green audit JSON per AGENTS.md test-adjustment policy.
